name: reminder-companion
description: A cute floating buddy named Suriya who nudges you to drink water, rest your eyes, stretch and walk — across every Antigravity / VS Code window.

commands.title: Companion: Nudge Me Now (next reminder type)

reminderCompanion.enabled.description: Turn the companion's automatic reminders on or off.

reminderCompanion.name.description: What the companion should call you. Leave empty for 'friend'.

reminderCompanion.breakMinutes.description: Minutes between screen-break (eye rest) reminders (0 disables).

reminderCompanion.idleMinutes.description: Minutes without activity in the IDE before you count as idle (reminders pause).

reminderCompanion.awayHours.description: Hours away before the companion welcomes you back.

reminderCompanion.snoozeMinutes.description: How long 'Not now' snoozes a reminder (grows if you keep saying no).

reminderCompanion.minGapMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between any two reminders.

reminderCompanion.notify.description: Also show reminders as a notification with Yes / Not now buttons.

reminderCompanion.floatingBuddy.description: Show the avatar and speech bubble in a small floating window on your desktop (macOS). Falls back to notifications if unavailable.

reminderCompanion.buddyCorner.description: Screen corner for the floating buddy.

reminderCompanion.companionName.description: The character's own name, used in his introductions.

scripts.test: node tests/build.js && node --no-warnings --test --test-force-exit tests/logic.test.ts tests/companion.test.ts tests/buddy.test.ts
scripts.package: npm run build:buddy && node esbuild.js --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository -o reminder-companion.vsix
scripts.build:buddy: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos12 buddy/Buddy.swift -o buddy/.arm64 -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos12 buddy/Buddy.swift -o buddy/.x86 -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit && lipo -create buddy/.arm64 buddy/.x86 -output buddy/companion-buddy && rm buddy/.arm64 buddy/.x86
